ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Guest-ly uses the camera to scan guest passes at the door and to photograph a floor plan or a receipt.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Guest-ly lets you pick photos for the wedding album, the wedding website, the floor plan and budget receipts.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Guest-ly can use biometric unlock instead of asking you to sign in again.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Guest-ly does not record audio. iOS shows this text only if a video with sound is ever captured, which the app does not do.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Guest-ly fills in a guest's name, phone and email from the contacts you choose to share. It never reads the rest of your address book.
